text: EXT. CITY PARK - DAY
A MAN (TIM) and a WOMAN (CARLY) stroll along a winding path. Sunlight filters through the trees. A SMALL FLUFFY DOG trots up to them, tail wagging.
Carly immediately crouches down, delighted.

speaker: CARLY
text: Hello! Aren't you a good boy! Where did you come from?
She glances up, expecting Tim to share her enthusiasm. Instead, Tim studies the dog with concern.

speaker: CARLY
text: What is it?

speaker: TIM
text: Oh, nothing... just surprised...

speaker: CARLY
text: What? Why?

speaker: TIM
text: It's just... you never talk to me like that.
Carly stands.

speaker: CARLY
text: What do you mean, you want me to talk to you like a dog?

speaker: TIM
text: No... of course not.

speaker: CARLY
text: Then what do you mean?

speaker: TIM
text: You actually seem happy to see him.

speaker: CARLY
text: Well of course I do! He's such a good boy!
She scratches the dog's head again.

speaker: TIM
text: Yes, but he's your ex-husband.
A beat.

speaker: CARLY
text: ...what?

speaker: TIM
text: Look at the way he's looking at you! That's the look of someone who's been inside you.

speaker: CARLY
text: Tim, don't be ridiculous. It's just a dog.

speaker: TIM
text: He's obviously not *just* a dog though, is he, Carly? This is so typical. How come you never see things from my point of view?

speaker: CARLY
text: I'm not even sure what I'm supposed to say to that.

speaker: TIM
text: Come here! Come and stand exactly where I'm standing and see things from my point of view for a change!

speaker: CARLY
text: ...Okay?
Carly steps into Tim's position.

speaker: CARLY
text: Oh my God, Steven!
ANGLE ON: The dog is now a MAN IN A DOG SUIT, sprawled suggestively
on the grass, giving Carly a smoldering look.

speaker: STEVEN
text: Oh for fuck's sake, Tim. She doesn't even love you.

speaker: CARLY
text: It's true, I do prefer Steven, but Tim has more money... so...
She gives a helpless shrug: *What are you gonna do?*
They all share a laugh.

speaker: TIM
text: Hahahahaha!

speaker: CARLY
text: Hahahahaha!

speaker: STEVEN
text: Hahahahaha!
Tim draws a gun and shoots Steven dead.
A PASSERBY and his wife gasps.

speaker: PASSERBY
text: You just shot that dog!

speaker: TIM
text: Relax, it's just my girlfriend's ex-husband. Come and stand on that spot and see for yourself.
The passerbys step into the spot.

speaker: PASSERBY
text: Ah, so it is! Haha, no worries.
They strolls off.
Tim and Carly casually step over Steven's body and walk away. Tim tosses the gun aside without looking.
Carly hangs on his arm.

speaker: CARLY
text: I was only joking about the money thing, darling. You know that, don't you?
Tim sighs.

speaker: TIM
text: Yeah, I know.
They disappear down the path, perfectly calm.
FADE OUT.
